thought.title: ReduceSum矢量归约 + MIX_AIC_1_1单AIV + 精简TBuf
thought.description: 将逐元素标量累加循环替换为AscendC::ReduceSum硬件矢量归约(O(N)→O(log N))。改用KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_1避免双AIV导致UB翻倍溢出(>256KB)。Direct block-to-row映射替代GetSubBlockIdx。TBuf从6个精简到3个(castBuf+castBuf2+computeBuf)。Gamma/beta per-row cast替代预加载fp32版本进一步节省UB。
thought.reason: 标量循环O(N)在Vector处理器上串行执行成为主导瓶颈。历史pattern reduce-sum-replace-scalar-loop直接适用。MIX_AIC_1_2导致两个AIV各自分配UB buffer总量超256KB引发越界，改为MIX_AIC_1_1稳定。TBuf精简借鉴历史case reduce-ub-buffers-direct-block-mapping经验。
thought.target_bottleneck: 标量累加循环O(N)在Vector处理器串行执行 + UB双倍分配超256KB

runtime.dsl_before: float sumVal=0.0f; for(int i=0;i<N;i++){sumVal += addFp32(i);} + KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_2 + 6TBuf
runtime.dsl_after: AscendC::ReduceSum<float>(addFp32, addFp32, reduceWork, N); float sumVal = addFp32(0); + KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_1 + 3TBuf
